It does NOT mean close but not the same.
vocab.example: The two toy cars look identical because they are the same color and size.
vocab.starter: Two things that are identical are _______ ...
vocab.why: Identical is a cool word for things that are exactly the same!

manip.task: Replace the adjective 'remarkable' with a different adjective.
examples: She did a really wonderful job on her test.
She did a really great job on her test.

vocab.def: So special or good that people notice and remember it.
vocab.simple: Remarkable means so amazing that everyone says wow!
nonex: It does NOT mean just okay.
It does NOT mean strange.
vocab.example: She did a remarkable job and the teacher was very proud.
vocab.why: Remarkable is a powerful word to show something is truly special!

corr.e: The first word of a sentence must be capitalized.

sentences.fixed: He is an outstanding friend to his class.

manip.task: Replace the adjective 'outstanding' with a different adjective.
examples: He is an amazing friend to his class.
He is an incredible friend to his class.

vocab.def: Much better than usual; standing out because it is so good.
vocab.simple: Outstanding means you are so good that you stand out from everyone else!
nonex: It does NOT mean just standing up.
It does NOT mean standing outside.
vocab.example: He is an outstanding friend who always helps his class.
vocab.starter: An outstanding thing about me is _______ ...
vocab.why: Outstanding is a wonderful word that shows someone is extra special!
